1 #!/usr/bin/env node
2 // bin/run-rounds.mjs — THE canonical Phase-3 round driver (T9, 2026-07-11).
3 //
4 // Promoted from the root-level run-ramanujan-round.mjs (which every real run had to
5 // discover by archaeology — journal 0001 hand-rolled a ConPTY harness, the 2026-06-19
6 // run role-played the engine's rules in sub-agents instead of running the engine).
7 // This is the documented operator path; the old filename remains as a thin shim.
8 //
9 // Faithful ENGINE mode: fresh-context sub-agents produce the cognition (reviewer
10 // findings, Judge verdict, Synthesizer steer, debate); this driver replays those
11 // through the REAL trio gates (tallyFindings >=2-agree, gateOneQuorum independence,
12 // the honest convergence tracker incl. the T8 CLEAN path, the suspiciously-dry
13 // guard) and assembles the deliverable. No re-implemented gate logic.
14 //
15 // Usage:
16 //   node bin/run-rounds.mjs <runDir> [--max-rounds N]
17 //     <runDir> holds round-<N>-input.json files:
18 //       { round, northStar, stakes:{...}|tier,
19 //         reviews:[{reviewer,angle,lineage,findings:[{claim_id?,topic,severity,traces_to_north_star,message}]}],
20 //         adjudications:{ judge:{...}, synthesizer:{...}, debate:{...} } }   (replay mode)
21 //   RESEARCHPRIME_LIVE_ROUND=1  -> reviewer/debate/judge seats go LIVE via family prefs
22 //     (agy down => honest HaltError, never silent self-review). Vacant reviews[]
23 //     SPAWN the G3 panel through that agent (journal 0057/0058) — do not paste.
24 //     Supplied non-vacant reviews still win (replay / resume). Artifact path on
25 //     the round input must be ABSOLUTE (journal 0002).
26 //   --max-rounds (default 8, env RESEARCHPRIME_MAX_ROUNDS): the HARD round budget — at
27 //     the cap the run stops with an honest NOT-CONVERGED state file; it never loops
28 //     unbounded and never fabricates convergence.
29 //
30 // Outputs in <runDir>: round-<N>-result.json per round; DELIVERABLE-ENGINE.json on
31 // convergence (dry OR clean, stamped); RUN-STATE.json always (resume = add the next
32 // round-input and re-run — every paid result is on disk, nothing is discarded).

67 function resolveRoundArtifact(inp, runDir) {
68   const raw = inp?.artifact ?? inp?.artifactPath ?? inp?.artifact_path ?? null;
69   if (typeof raw !== 'string' || !raw.trim()) return null;
70   const p = raw.trim();
71   if (path.win32.isAbsolute(p) || path.posix.isAbsolute(p)) return p;
72   const joined = path.resolve(runDir, p);
73   if (path.win32.isAbsolute(joined) || path.posix.isAbsolute(joined)) return joined;
74   return null;
75 }

77 function writeHaltRecord(runDir, reason, extra = {}) {
78   try {
79     fs.writeFileSync(path.join(runDir, 'HALT-RECORD.json'), JSON.stringify({
80       status: 'HALTED', reason, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), ...extra,
81     }, null, 2));
82   } catch { /* record is best-effort; the halt itself is the law */ }
83 }

104   const allInputs = fs.readdirSync(runDir)
105     .filter((f) => /^round-\d+-input\.json$/.test(f))
106     .sort((a, b) => parseInt(a.match(/\d+/)[0]) - parseInt(b.match(/\d+/)[0]))
107     .map((f) => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(runDir, f), 'utf8')));
108   if (!allInputs.length) throw new Error(`no round-*-input.json found in ${runDir}`);

110   // FIELD LAWS, mechanized (2026-08-25, John-ratified card — each of these burned a real
111   // round as SKILL.md prose; now the engine HALTs loudly at load, one line, never a silent
112   // auto-fix). Law 1: traces_to_north_star is the STRING 'yes'/'no' — a boolean silently
113   // demotes EVERY finding (2026-08-15). Law 2: pasted agy replies may arrive ```-fenced
114   // ~1-in-6 (0052) — a fenced blob in an input field is a transcription defect, not data.
115   // Law 3: any *path* field must be ABSOLUTE (0002 — agy's CWD is never reliable).
116   // (Hardening 2026-08-25: violations write HALT-RECORD.json like every other halt; the
117   // fence law fires only on a WHOLE-string fence wrap — the pasted-blob signature — so a
118   // finding message that merely QUOTES fenced code passes; the path law fires only on
119   // filesystem-looking values (has a separator, no scheme) and accepts either OS's
120   // absolute form — trio run dirs replay cross-OS.)
121   try {
122     for (const input of allInputs) {
123       const rn = input?.round ?? '?';
124       for (const rev of input?.reviews ?? []) {
125         for (const f of rev?.findings ?? []) {
126           const t = f?.traces_to_north_star;
127           if (t !== 'yes' && t !== 'no') {
128             throw new Error(`FIELD-LAW HALT round ${rn} reviewer ${rev?.reviewer ?? '?'} topic "${f?.topic ?? '?'}": traces_to_north_star must be the STRING 'yes' or 'no', got ${JSON.stringify(t)} — a non-string silently demotes every finding`);
129           }
130         }
131       }
132       const walk = (obj, at) => {
133         if (obj == null) return;
134         if (typeof obj === 'string') {
135           const s = obj.trim();
136           if (s.startsWith('```') && s.endsWith('```') && s.length > 6) {
137             throw new Error(`FIELD-LAW HALT round ${rn} at ${at}: value is a whole \`\`\`-fenced block — a fenced agy reply was pasted as data; strip the fence and re-run (journal 0052)`);
138           }
139           return;
140         }
141         if (Array.isArray(obj)) { obj.forEach((v, i) => walk(v, `${at}[${i}]`)); return; }
142         if (typeof obj === 'object') {
143           for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
144             if (/path$/i.test(k) && typeof v === 'string' && v
145                 && /[\\/]/.test(v) && !/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(v)
146                 && !(path.win32.isAbsolute(v) || path.posix.isAbsolute(v))) {
147               throw new Error(`FIELD-LAW HALT round ${rn} at ${at}.${k}: "${v}" is not an ABSOLUTE path — agy's CWD is never reliable (journal 0002)`);
148             }
149             walk(v, `${at}.${k}`);
150           }
151         }
152       };
153       walk(input, `round-${rn}-input`);
154     }
155   } catch (e) {

474     }
475     const out = { deliverable, convergence, honesty, tier, thresholds, unresolvedHigh };
476     fs.writeFileSync(path.join(runDir, 'DELIVERABLE-ENGINE.json'), JSON.stringify(out, null, 2));
477     log(`\nCONVERGED (${convergence.mode}). cross_model=${deliverable.cross_model} verified=${deliverable.verified} rho_mode=${calibration.mode}. Wrote DELIVERABLE-ENGINE.json (output-conformance OK)`);
478   } else {
479     log(capped
480       ? `\nROUND BUDGET HIT (${cap}) without convergence — honest stop; open blockers are in RUN-STATE.json (nothing discarded).`
481       : `\nNOT converged yet — need dryStreak ${thresholds.N} (or ${thresholds.N + 1} consecutive clean rounds); add the next round-input after fixing blockers and re-run.`);
482   }
483 
484   // RUN-STATE.json: the durable state — this file IS the resume mechanism (SKILL.md's
485   // honest durability story: round inputs/results on disk, re-run to continue).
486   const runState = {
487     convergence, honesty, tier, thresholds, unresolvedHigh, substrateFamilies,
488     openBlockers: [...priorBlockerIds],
489     processedRounds: roundResults.map((r) => r.round),
490   };
491   fs.writeFileSync(path.join(runDir, 'RUN-STATE.json'), JSON.stringify(runState, null, 2));
492 
493   // Run capture for training (Skill Foundry AGENTS.md "Run capture") — best-effort.
494   // Skipped under the test runner (P2 2026-07-25): fixture runs must never pollute
495   // the training feed (same rule as gandalf/tidy-idy).
496   try {
497     if (env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT || process.env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT) return { convergence, honesty, tier, deliverable, runState };
498     const skillDir = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
499     const dir = path.join(skillDir, 'journal', 'runs');
500     fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
501     fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, `${started.replace(/[:.]/g, '-')}-${Math.abs(Date.now() % 100000)}.json`),
502       JSON.stringify({
503         skill: 'researchPrime', tier: LIVE_ROUND ? 'live-cross-family' : 'replay',
504         started, ended: new Date().toISOString(),
505         input: runDir, params: { maxRounds: cap, live: LIVE_ROUND, spawnPanel: spawn, stakesTier: tier },
506         output: finalState.converged ? path.join(runDir, 'DELIVERABLE-ENGINE.json') : path.join(runDir, 'RUN-STATE.json'),
507         result: finalState.converged ? `converged (${convergence.mode})` : (capped ? 'round budget hit — honest stop' : 'not converged — awaiting next round'),
508         cross_model: deliverable?.cross_model ?? (substrateFamilies.length > 1),
509         models: substrateFamilies,
510         duration_s: Math.round((Date.now() - t0) / 1000),
511         journal_ref: null,
512       }, null, 2) + '\n');
513   } catch { /* capture is best-effort */ }
514 
515   return { convergence, honesty, tier, deliverable, runState };
516 }
517 
518 // ---- CLI ----
519 function invokedDirectly() {
520   const entry = process.argv[1];
521   if (!entry) return false;
522   try { return path.resolve(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) === path.resolve(entry); } catch { return false; }
523 }
524 if (invokedDirectly()) {
525   const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
526   const runDir = argv.find((a) => !a.startsWith('--'));
527   const mrIdx = argv.indexOf('--max-rounds');
528   const maxRounds = mrIdx >= 0 ? Number(argv[mrIdx + 1]) : null;
529   if (!runDir) { console.error('usage: node bin/run-rounds.mjs <runDir> [--max-rounds N]'); process.exit(2); }
530   runRounds(runDir, { maxRounds }).catch((err) => {
531     console.error(`run-rounds: ${err?.message ?? err}`);
532     process.exit(1);
533   });
534 }
